tools.name: get_interview_sprint_offer
tools.description: Read the current Evercraft Interview Sprint terms. Read-only. Creates no checkout or payment obligation.

tools.name: prepare_interview_sprint_checkout
tools.description: Only after the human explicitly agrees to pay $19 for the 7-day Interview Sprint, prepare a secure Evercraft Payments checkout. Checkout creation is not payment proof.

tools.name: get_interview_sprint_status
tools.description: Verify the Evercraft Payments checkout and, only after provider-confirmed payment, return the bounded 7-day Career Sprint access token and remaining premium actions.

tools.name: run_interview_sprint_action
tools.description: Consume one verified premium action for pre-interview preparation. Supports role-specific question generation, practice-answer evaluation, story recovery, and interview planning. Not for covert live-interview answer feeding.

tools.name: get_career_command_capabilities
tools.description: Read Career Command machine-commerce boundaries and supported premium practice actions.
